//: Institution-operations pages per portal. Read by lib/portals.ts (navigation), lib/permissions.tsx (route gating) and scripts/generate-ops-pages.mjs (page files). Permission keys mirror the API's requirePermission gates.

today.title: Today
today.desc: What needs you now, with the numbers that matter.

automations.title: Automations
automations.desc: What needs you today, drafts to confirm, your own reminders and reports, and the school's automations with when they run, who they reach and a preview of each message.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.desc: Decisions waiting on you, requests you raised, delegation and approval rules.

campus.title: Campus World
campus.desc: Your campus in 3D: rooms, what is scheduled, bookings, maintenance and events.

live.title: Live details
live.desc: What is happening now in a room, class, teacher's day, bus, lab, department, zone or the gate, refreshed every 15 seconds and limited to what you may see.

lectures.title: Digital Lectures
lectures.desc: Online classes and meetings: schedule, join, recordings and material.

syllabus.title: Syllabus & Modules
syllabus.desc: Each subject as modules with dates and topics: what is being taught now, and whether it is on plan.

correspondence.title: Correspondence
correspondence.desc: Letters and circulars from the board, government, university and district office — reply, approve, dispatch, close with evidence.

compliance.title: Compliance Centre
compliance.desc: Obligations, regulatory returns, licences, policies, trainings and official notices.

verification.title: Background Verification
verification.desc: Staff, teacher, driver and vendor checks with the principal's final decision.

events.title: Events & Fests
events.desc: Propose, approve, prepare and close out events, fests, meetings and visits.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.desc: Rooms and spaces, bookings and maintenance.

contracts.title: Agreements
contracts.desc: Vendor, service, lease, transport and partnership agreements with renewal dates.

governance.title: Board & Committees
governance.desc: Trustee, SMC and governing body meetings — agenda, minutes, resolutions and actions.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.desc: Pay structures, statutory rules, payroll runs, bank file, payment confirmation and statutory filings.

procurement.title: Procurement
procurement.desc: Purchase requests, quotes, orders, receipts, invoices, payments and assets.

budgets.title: Budgets & Funding
budgets.desc: Budgets with commitments and actuals; funding proposals and loan comparison.

organization.title: Organisation Map
organization.desc: Departments, positions and people — built from appointments.

institution.title: Institution Profile
institution.desc: Legal entity, campuses, affiliations, terminology and public disclosures.

marketing.title: Marketing & Admissions
marketing.desc: Funnel, campaigns, creative, seats and counselling.

newsroom.title: Newsroom
newsroom.desc: Stories, events, achievements, circles and mentoring.

mentoring.title: Mentoring
mentoring.desc: Seniors and alumni who help — always supervised for students.

clubs.title: Clubs & Teams
clubs.desc: Sports, arts and other clubs and teams: joining with parent consent and teacher approval, places and waiting list, sessions and registers, fixtures, house points, kit and each student's participation portfolio.

showcase.title: Showcase
showcase.desc: Previous class and term top rankers and achievements in sports, arts and olympiads, published by the school with each family's consent.

safeguarding.title: Safeguarding
safeguarding.desc: Raise a concern. Child-protection reporting never waits for internal approval.

policies.title: My Policies & Trainings
policies.desc: Policies to read and acknowledge, your trainings, and how we contact you.

trainings.title: My Policies & Trainings
trainings.desc: Policies to read and acknowledge, your trainings, and how we contact you.

messaging.title: Messages Sent
messaging.desc: WhatsApp/SMS/email notifications with their real delivery status.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.desc: Figures for any period against a comparison, by department, with definitions, trends, drill-down and export.

reports.title: Quarterly Reports
reports.desc: Versioned quarterly decision reports: figures, comparisons, budget variance, renewals and decisions. Download as PDF or CSV.

tasks.title: My Tasks
tasks.desc: Everything due — bills, renewals, services, inspections and follow-ups — with owners, reminders and evidence.

fleet.title: Transport & Fleet
fleet.desc: Vehicles and their papers, today's trips with seats, boarding and safe handover, the live board and transport alerts.

bus-duty.title: My Bus Duty
bus-duty.desc: Trips where you are the attendant: seats, boarding, handover to an authorised adult and the end-of-trip check.

bus-today.title: My Bus Today
bus-today.desc: Today's bus for your child: status, stop and an estimated arrival.

gate.title: Gate & Visitors
gate.desc: Visitors and contractors, child pickup and release, ID card checkpoints and the emergency roster.

pickup.title: Pickup & Gate
pickup.desc: Who may collect your child, time-limited delegates confirmed by a code, and today's gate and bus checkpoints.

outpass.title: Hostel Out-pass
outpass.desc: Out-pass requests, guardian confirmation, approval, gate exit and return, late returns.

my-outpass.title: Hostel Out-pass
my-outpass.desc: Ask for an out-pass, confirm your child's request and follow it to return.

camera.title: Camera Review (pilot)
camera.desc: Optional pilot: unverified camera observations for trained human review. No identification.

class-check-in.title: Class Check-in
class-check-in.desc: Mark yourself in class for each period you teach or cover.

ptm.title: PTM
ptm.desc: Parent–teacher meetings: rounds, teacher availability, booking for each child, waiting list, check-in, child briefing and outcomes.

review-calls.title: Review Calls
review-calls.desc: Follow-up calls with families: attempts, private notes, agreed actions and the next follow-up.

conversations.title: Parent Messages
conversations.desc: Messages between families and teachers about a child, with read receipts and an unanswered queue.

staff-leave.title: Staff Leave
staff-leave.desc: Apply for leave and see your balance; HR and the principal approve and set leave policies.

cover.title: Cover
cover.desc: Today's absences, the lessons they affect, and substitutes proposed and confirmed.

report-cards.title: Report Cards
report-cards.desc: Term report cards: prepared from published marks, moderated, published and downloadable.

labs.title: Labs
labs.desc: Science and computer labs: stock with expiry, issue and return with scanning, instruments and calibration, computers and software seats, practicals and incidents.

bills.title: Bills & Services
bills.desc: Recurring bills and service contracts, payments confirmed against the bank, AMC visits, renewals, the review queue and the cost dashboard.

concessions.title: Fee Concessions
concessions.desc: Concession schemes, and concessions, credit notes and voids on issued invoices through approval.

accounts-export.title: Accounts Export
accounts-export.desc: Vouchers for Tally (XML or CSV) and the GST summary of taxable fee lines, for any date range.

alumni.title: Alumni
alumni.desc: Former students and staff: alumni circles, the directory (name and batch unless a person shares more), batches and served years, and reunions.

alumni-manage.title: Alumni
alumni-manage.desc: Move graduates and leavers to alumni, review alumni posts, plan reunions and keep batches right.

planner.title: My Planner
planner.desc: Homework due, quizzes, exams and a suggested study week built from your own marks; board-registration details to check in Classes 10 and 12.

give-back.title: Opportunities
give-back.desc: Career talks, mentoring, internships and jobs offered by alumni. Reviewed by the school; students ask through the alumni coordinator.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.desc: Request a character, study or leaving certificate from your school record and download it when the office issues it.

social.title: Social Publishing
social.desc: Share public newsroom stories to the school's social accounts: choose networks, consent re-checked at publishing, and each network's status. Simulated until provider credentials are connected.

digest.title: Daily Digest
digest.desc: Headlines from feeds the school approved, matched to the interests you choose.

profile-links.title: Profile Links
profile-links.desc: LinkedIn, Instagram, GitHub and a personal site on a student's profile — private unless the student and, for a minor, a guardian agree.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.desc: Trees and survival checks, waste by stream with vendor receipts, compost, water and energy, sanitation duties, verified eco points, and evidence packs to support your submissions.

eco-points.title: Eco points
eco-points.desc: The school's and each class's verified eco points, and the latest verified green activities.

library-labels.title: Labels & scan desk
library-labels.desc: Accession numbers per copy, printable barcode labels, and scan-to-issue and scan-to-return with a barcode scanner.

library-desk.title: Library desk
library-desk.desc: Today's overdue loans and reminders, reservations and the hold shelf, fines, reading challenges, circulation insights and next-read suggestions.

hostel-life.title: Hostel life
hostel-life.desc: Night and morning roll call, the mess menu and tonight's headcount, the kitchen allergy list, and incidents with the record of each call to the family.

followups.title: Follow-ups
followups.desc: Admission enquiries to call today: overdue, due today, never contacted and with no next step, sorted by an explained warmth score; log a follow-up in one step; counsellor response and conversion.

data-protection.title: Data protection & committees
data-protection.desc: Readiness checklist (CBSE certificates, statutory committees, data requests, breaches, training), DPDP data-principal requests, the breach register with the 72-hour clock, and statutory committees.

ai-drafts.title: AI drafts
ai-drafts.desc: Drafts of letters, circulars, minutes, lesson-plan outlines and report-card remarks to copy and edit. Nothing is sent or saved.

online-applications.title: Online applications
online-applications.desc: Applications from the school's public admission form, with their documents. Each is a new lead in the admissions CRM.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.desc: Offline and online campaigns: banners, pamphlets, posters, newspaper and radio, open houses and society stalls with placements, cost, approval, short links, QR codes and promo codes, and the enquiries and admissions each brought.

connectors.title: Ad connectors
connectors.desc: Meta, Google Ads, Google Analytics, YouTube, LinkedIn and CSV: import each platform's export for spend, clicks and leads, the lead webhook, and a clearly labelled simulated sample.

attribution.title: Attribution & ROI
attribution.desc: Enquiries, visits, applications and admissions by campaign and channel, with cost per enquiry, cost per admission and ROI.

support-plans.title: Support Plans
support-plans.desc: Student support plans from the risk signals, attendance and marks: measurable goals with review dates, actions with owners, progress reviews and closure. Families see the summary and goals for their own child.

portfolio.title: Competency Portfolio
portfolio.desc: Competencies with evidence from school records and teachers, a three-level rubric, the student's reflections and a PDF. Families and students see only their own.

scenarios.title: Scenario Planning
scenarios.desc: What-if projections 1 to 5 years ahead from current actuals: enrolment, fees, staffing, transport and budget. Saved scenarios, side-by-side comparison and charts, always labelled as projections.

teacher-presence.title: Teacher Presence
teacher-presence.desc: Each timetabled lesson today: whether the teacher or a substitute checked in, by tap or a reviewer-confirmed camera observation. The timetable names the teacher; no camera identifies anyone.

health.title: Health
health.desc: The health room: visits, medication plans with parent consent, the medication record, first-aid stock, care notes, immunisations, screenings and health cards. Every clinical detail is encrypted and every read is audited.

care-notes.title: Care Notes
care-notes.desc: Short care notes for children in your class that their parents agreed to share, e.g. a severe allergy and where the medicine is kept. Nothing else from the health record.

health-summary.title: Health Room
health-summary.desc: Health-room figures as counts only: visits by outcome, medication plans, missed doses, stock to replace. No names or details.

finance-reports.title: Finance Reports
finance-reports.desc: Collections by day, mode, cashier, fee head and class; the day book; overdue fees by age with reminders; audit flags; the day-end cash close.

recruitment.title: Recruitment
recruitment.desc: Vacancies and the candidate pipeline: screening, demo lesson, interview scorecards, offer letter drafts and background verification before joining.

staff-exits.title: Staff Exits
staff-exits.desc: Resignations and retirements: notice, department clearances, exit interview, the full-and-final worksheet (gratuity, leave encashment) and letters.

health-watch.title: Health Watch
health-watch.desc: Possible clusters of illness in a class, children seen often, immunisations due, screening coverage and the health-room register.

shifts.title: Shifts & Bells
shifts.desc: School shifts (morning, afternoon or more) with their own bell schedules: arrival, assembly, periods, breaks, lunch, dispersal and clubs. Assign classes to a shift; room clashes between shifts are refused. Campus World and the timetable follow each class's shift.

lesson-plans.title: Lesson Plans
lesson-plans.desc: Plan each lesson (objectives, 5E flow, NEP pedagogies, competency check, homework), start from a suggestion built from your syllabus module, copy it to other sections and mark it taught: the syllabus tracker and homework follow.

question-bank.title: Question Bank & Papers
question-bank.desc: The shared question bank per subject and class, and question papers built from a blueprint with the checks a head of department makes: total marks, competency-based share, cognitive levels and chapter spread.

cpd-hours.title: CPD Hours
cpd-hours.desc: Your professional development hours this year against the CBSE reference of 50 (25 external, 25 in-house, by NPST area); in-house trainings you attended count by themselves. HR and the principal verify entries.

professional-profile.title: Professional Profile
professional-profile.desc: Your qualifications, subjects, experience, certifications and a short bio, each with its own Show to families switch (off until you turn it on).

staff-profiles.title: Staff Profiles
staff-profiles.desc: Every staff member's professional profile, how complete it is and what each shares with families. HR may correct details; the family-sharing choice stays the person's own.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.desc: Competitions, olympiads, scholarships and programmes matched to you, and the weekly and monthly newsletter with flashcards and a quiz.

newsletter-desk.title: Newsletter Desk
newsletter-desk.desc: Review opportunities, publish the weekly and monthly newsletter, moderate comments and see how it is read.
